_comment: Student registry. KEY = card UID exactly as the reader prints it (uppercase hex).
parentChatId: ONE Telegram chat id per student. Four students, four different ids
means four phones each getting only their own child's alerts.
EVERY id listed here must have pressed START on your bot, or Telegram refuses the
message with 'chat not found'. Use the VERIFY button on the Tap Processing tab to
check all of them at once before a demo.
Siblings CAN share an id - the verifier only messages each id once.
After editing, click 'Load student DB'. No restart needed.
